$comment: Design Engineering Toolkit CLI family — BuildConfig. Major version 1 (issue #28 coordinator correction C1): the declarative input of the one-shot `det build --config` orchestrator, which drives the ALREADY-SHIPPED commands (inspect -> extract -> compose) through their exact existing contracts and emits a versioned build bundle + build manifest (schemas/cli/build-manifest.schema.json). This config introduces NO new engine, NO defaults and NO provider access: every path is explicit caller input, resolved relative to the config file's own directory (portable per-project configs); a `live` design-source mode is deliberately NOT representable in major 1 — a build runs from an offline snapshot/tree document only, and any live-source need must go through a separately authorized adapter (fail closed, never claimed). The config never points at a CMS/store/theme write target: the build is offline computation; preview installation into a checkout is an explicitly operator-gated step outside this contract. Issue #70 additive minor: the optional `cmsInstall` block does NOT point the build at a write target — it declares the ONE explicit, operator-executed CMS target that the generated install bundle (`install-homepage.php` + companions) addresses when the bundle is later executed by its operator inside an authorized installation of the target platform; DET itself still never writes, and an absent block is recorded honestly as a build-manifest gap (CMS_INSTALL_TARGET_UNDECLARED).
title: Design Engineering Toolkit — Build Config

profileId.description: The converter profile id this build drives (documentational; the pinned artifacts carry the authoritative identity checks).

profile.description: Path of the converter profile file (relative to this config file's directory, or absolute).

mode.description: Major 1 supports OFFLINE snapshot/tree-document builds only. A live design-source read requires its own authorized adapter and is not expressible here — the build fails closed rather than approximating one.

project.description: Design-source project root containing the tree document (relative to this config file, or absolute).

designFile.description: Tree-document filename inside the project root (plain filename; the extract adapter's own traversal guards apply).

designNode.description: Caller-selected root locator inside the tree document — never a default.

project.description: Platform checkout path for the read-only capability probe (relative to this config file, or absolute). Present -> the build runs `det inspect` first; absent -> `registry` is required.

registry.description: Path of a pre-built capability-registry.json to reuse (required when capabilityProbe is absent; when both are present the probe wins and this field is rejected as ambiguous).

bindings.description: Path of the component binding map (relative to this config file, or absolute).

content.description: Path of the content manifest (relative to this config file, or absolute).

projection.description: Optional path of the semantic projection document (relative to this config file, or absolute).

outputDir.description: Default build-bundle output directory (relative to this config file, or absolute). The --out CLI flag overrides it; exactly one of the two must be present.

cmsInstall.description: Issue #70 additive minor: the ONE explicit CMS install target the generated operator bundle addresses. Every field is required and nothing is defaulted — no invented target. The dedicated page identifier must NOT be the store's default homepage: the generated installer never reads or writes the store config value web/default/cms_home_page and never touches any other CMS page; it resolves strictly by this identifier within this store scope and refuses loudly when an existing page with the same identifier belongs to a different store set. When present and composition exits 0, the bundle root additionally carries install-homepage.php (cms-installer), the composed native content under its frozen operator-facing file name (native-content-copy), mapping-and-gaps.json (mapping-gap-report) and README.md (operator-readme); DET itself still never writes — the installer is operator-executed inside an authorized installation.

identifier.description: The CMS page identifier the installer addresses, exclusively — a dedicated page, never the store default homepage key.

title.description: The CMS page title written by the installer (echoed verbatim; no default).

storeId.description: The store scope the installer writes into (0 = all store views); the page is stored with this exact scope and any existing page with the same identifier under a different store set refuses the run.

active.description: Whether the installed CMS page is active.

allOf.description: Without a capability probe, a pre-built registry path is mandatory — the build never invents capability evidence.
Ambiguity guard: a probe and a pre-built registry together are a caller error — the build refuses to choose.
